games.shortDescription: Open World Power Suit Supervillain Game
games.longDescription:
Exo Mayhem is a supervillain power-suit action game where you can soar freely through the skies of a lush multi-biome mall and unleash mayhem and destruction. You will fight, shoot, stab, explode, destroy, and conquer in Paradise Mall with over 60 missions and challenges as you upgrade your weapons and exo suit with over 42 different weapons and powers to unlock and upgrade. This is the ultimate powersuit experience!

Key Features:

Fully Destructible Environments:

Every store in Paradise Mall features destructible environments. punch, slice, shoot, or explode the stores and complete robbery missions to unlock new powers and weapons.

Guns, Powers, and Super-suits:

Upgrade your super-suit with new weapons, powers, and skins as you do missions for the people of Paradise Mall, or play in sandbox mode to be a menace from the start with a fully kitted super-suit.

Supervillain Style Movement:

The movement in Exo Mayhem was handcrafted to feel grandiose, fast, and fluid with upgrades to your exo suit allowing you to use superspeed via thruster running, true flight to soar through the skies, and a Just Cause inspired grapnel hook to traverse Paradise Mall quickly and effectively. Combine each of these with different weapons and powers and you become unstoppable!

Gore, Blood, Guts, and Burns:

Exo Mayhem has a realistic NPC reaction system for headshots, dismemberment, gut slices, explosion damage, fire, and adrenaline. When you attack an NPC in Paradise Mall they will react realistically and bleed out, limp, run, or become scorched from fire depending on what weapon and power you used.

Zombies!:
Fight your way through endless zombie hordes in the Exo-Zombies game mode as you journey through a world on the brink of collapse. Each zombie you kill earns money and levels you up with a roguelike progression system. If you prefer to start with everything unlocked, try the Sandbox Mode, where all weapons and powers are available from the start.

Evotinction is a thought provoking, hack and stealth game that challenges the relationship between evolution and extinction. 

As AI, gene editing and quantum entanglement technologies develop, its potential threat grows. One day our greatest achievement, will turn on us. 

A cutting-edge research facility has been taken over by virus infected AI drones which have wiped out the humans.  All connections to the outside have been cut off. There are no signs of human life left in the facility. Thomas Liu, the leader of the AI development department stands alone in the facility, determined to stop the virus from spreading to the outside world and prevent ‘extinction by evolution’ for humanity. 

Whilst he may not be combat trained, as a tech savvy researcher, Thomas is able to hack, disrupt and manipulate these rouge AI’s to guide himself through the facility. Long-range Signal Disrupting, Radio and Electromagnetic jamming, Hologram Illusion, Malware Implant, System Takeover, IFF Spoofing... Make use of the Doctors full arsenal of gadgets to hack a way to the heart of the facility. 

Features:

Multiple hacks and skills allow you to play each level in numerous different ways.

Numerous different enemies, each with their own behaviours, purpose and skills.

Seamless semi-open world which the player can revisit to find missing objectives or collectibles.

Multiple modes including NG+ mode with new super powerful skills, challenge mode with over 30 levels and a time attack mode for players to record their times.

SPEED AND SPECTACLE

From streets and stadiums to deserts, mountains and a tropical paradise - Track design in EXOcars pays close attention to landscape, surface type, and terrain relief.

Featuring ramps, drifts, and natural obstacles, it makes you feel like an actual driver of a roaring buggy car, speeding through stunning scenery!

FEEL THE ROAD

EXOcars offers high graphical fidelity with rock-solid framerate.

In addition to that, the game is based on real car physics, ensuring a unique and immersive driving experience. Suspension dynamics and track surface interactions make every race feel fresh and thrilling.

СUSTOMIZE YOUR CAR

Make your ride truly yours! Customize the color, wheels, and more to match your style and stand out on the track. Mix, match, and create a look that’s as unique as your driving!

NEW FEATURES IN EXOCARS

Car Tuning: Fine-tune your car’s suspension, tires, engine power, and other components for the perfect setup.

Enemy AI Races: Compete against AI enemies in standard races or take on combat challenges with weapons for an extra thrill.

Training Mode: Practice your driving skills in the new training mode before hitting the tracks.

CHALLENGE YOUR SKILLS

In each single-player race, you'll face off against ghosts of real opponents matched to your skill level, allowing you to progress and become a top-notch pilot organically. You can also challenge AI opponents, pushing your skills to the limit as you compete for the top spot.

Whether you’re a casual driver or a seasoned champion, the game adapts to your skill level, ensuring a fun and challenging experience.

READY TO RELEASE THE BRAKE?

Carving through the wilderness or tearing up the asphalt, EXOcars promises an unparalleled experience that will keep you coming back for more.

As wars tore the globe apart and overpopulation pushed humanity to the brink, a lifeline emerged: The Arcade, a virtual world offering escape. In this digital utopia, everything is vibrant and shiny, everything runs smoothly... or so we’ve been led to believe.

Keep yourself busy with activities:
The Arcade is brimming with things to do, with new minigames around every corner of the city. No time will be wasted because even something as simple as playing dice with a cat can boost a useful stat.

Find. Your. Parents.

To reunite with her family, she’ll need to confront her deepest fears and doubts, pushing through a web of deception and uncertainty.

games.shortDescription: Get ready for a logistic challenge
games.longDescription:
Get ready for a logistic challenge in the next part of the best-selling series, which has been sold in over 120,000 copies! In Farm Manager 2022, as a farm manager, you have to ensure the right level of harvest, employee satisfaction, animal health, equipment efficiency and proper crop processing. You can buy new plots and use materials from abandoned buildings to expand your farm. Thanks to the new, more intuitive interface, employee management is even simpler.

In Farm Manager 2022 you will find even more plant species to grow. Now also organic ones! Grow celery, carrots, currants, gooseberries, onions and more. Observe plant growth. The new mechanics allow automatic field management using available employees and machines.

Enjoy a variety of machines that you can use when working in the field. Buy and sell them on the stock market. Look for bargains among used machines.

In Farm Manager 2022 you will find bees, sheep, goats, chickens, turkeys, ducks, geese and cows. For the first time, you will be able to set up a fish farm, ostrich, wild boar and quail farm.

Logistics center, mechanic’s garage, veterinary center and much more! The logistics center will allow you to transport larger quantities of resources and products easier and faster. In the mechanic’s garage, they will take care of your agricultural machinery. Employees from the veterinary center will ensure the health of your farm animals.

Prepare fields in spring, care for plants in summer, harvest crops in autumn and grow plants in greenhouses in winter. The weather can be dangerous for your farm. Heavy rain and hail may affect crop harvesting, and a thunderstorm can cause a fire that will damage your farm.

A satisfied employee is a good employee! Hire permanent and seasonal employees. Keep employees satisfied, control payroll and overtime. Increase their qualifications through trainings. Remember that everyone deserves a rest. Angry employees can leave at any time, so it’s really worth taking care of them.

games.imagesHtml: 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗
games.longDescription:
One strike decides your fate:

Enter a world of silhouettes and steel in Fatal Slash, a minimalist 2D dueling game of precision, timing, and tension. Every encounter is a deadly test where a single cut can end the fight. There are no long combos or super moves - only patience, skill, and the courage to strike first.


The Way of the Duel:

Face a path of ten opponents, each a master of a different style. Study their patterns, read their intent, and find the moment to strike. Victory is instant - but so is defeat. If your blade falters, the path ends.

Between matches, your performance is scored and added to the global leaderboards. Can you climb to the top and prove yourself the ultimate shadow warrior?


Features:

One-Hit Kill Combat
Every duel is decided by a single blow. Reflexes, discipline, and deception are your only weapons.

Minimalist Silhouette Style
A striking world inspired by Japanese ink painting and classic samurai cinema.

Two Stances, Infinite Possibilities
Switch between high and low guard to change your attack reach and defense options. A subtle stance shift can mean life or death.

Feints, Parries, and Precision
Trick your foe with false slashes, deflect attacks at the perfect moment, or risk everything on a counter cut.

Local Versus Mode
Challenge a friend in a battle of timing and nerves. First to three strikes wins.

Duel Mode
Follow the Path of Shadows and defeat ten unique warriors, culminating in a legendary final duel.

Endless Mode
Test your endurance in an infinite gauntlet of escalating opponents and climb the online leaderboards.

Cinematic Percussion Soundtrack
A thunder of taiko drums and silence between strikes. Every hit resonates with power.

Instant Restarts
No menus, no waiting - defeat, learn, and try again. Each duel lasts seconds, but mastery takes a lifetime.

games.shortDescription: It's safer in the dark.
games.longDescription:
Fear the Spotlight is an atmospheric third-person horror adventure with a disturbing mystery to unravel. Sneak into school after hours with Vivian and Amy, survive a séance gone wrong, solve tactile puzzles, and, whatever you do, stay out of the spotlight…

Sunnyside High has a dark history. When Vivian enters the deserted corridors for a seance with the rebellious Amy, she suddenly ends up alone, and at the mercy of the monster who wanders the halls. Vivian must avoid its gaze, find her friend, and uncover the disturbing, murderous truth of a decades old tragedy. Fear the Spotlight is a creepy love letter to classic 90s horror experiences with a focus of rich storytelling, puzzle solving, and a tense atmosphere. This is a perfect narrative horror game for those new to the genre.

ESCAPE THE NIGHTMARE
The séance went terribly wrong. Amy has disappeared, and the school has transformed into a nightmarish version of its former self. Play as Vivian to uncover a dark hidden past while attempting to save both you and your friend

DELIGHTFULLY HORRIFYING GAMEPLAY
* Sneak to avoid detection from an unknown entity in tense hand-crafted stealth moments as Vivian explores the ominous darkness of the school corridors
* Solve highly tactile puzzles that pay homage to classic genre favorites while evolving gameplay to satisfy modern horror fans
* Explore the eerie setting of a derelict Sunnyside High with a torch, screwdriver, wrench, and more to uncover a web of mysteries

1990s ATMOSPHERIC DREAD
Explore the hellish version of Sunnyside High as Vivian in this ode to classic 90’s teen horror. A retro art style, tense audio design, and a nostalgic setting will delight both veteran fans and those new to the horror genre

AN EXPANDED STORY
Dive even deeper into the dark world of Fear the Spotlight with an extensive additional storyline

Fear the Spotlight is the first title to be published by Blumhouse Games, a video games label within Blumhouse Productions focused on championing the most creative and unique takes on the horror genre.
